job: Show the direction of a number in a few pixels beside it.
purpose: A tiny line or bar shape drawn from data-values. It is a shape, not a reading: put it beside a figure. With no data-tone it colours itself by trend, up as success and down as danger; data-invert flips that where lower is better. data-type="bars" draws bars; data-area fills under the line; data-dot ends it on a dot.
useWhen: A stat tile, table cell or list row shows a number and its recent trend.
There is no room for axes or a tooltip.

avoidWhen.when: Readers need exact values or a time axis.

states.name: good
states.how: data-trend="good"; stamped by script; the line is green

variants.useWhen: The sparkline fills the width of its container.
On a bar sparkline, the last bar is at full strength.
